data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: How do I tell my parents that I am gay without them freaking out? ASSISTANT:

It is important to remember that your parents love you unconditionally and will always be there for you. There is no need to freak out. It would be best to approach the conversation calmly and explain your feelings. Acknowledge any fear or concern they may have, and reassure them that you will always be there for them.
